content:
**Radscorpion Steak** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A cooked piece of Radscorpion Meat.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Radscorpion Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Radscorpion Meat | | Radscorpion Steak (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having picked up Radscorpion Meat for the first time.
